$description: Controlled vocabularies. Every enum-valued field in every other dataset resolves to a term here. IDs are namespaced <dimension>:<slug> and are never renamed.

actor.label: Data subject
actor.note: The protected party under the GDPR.

actor.label: Intermediary service
actor.note: DSA base tier: mere conduit, caching, hosting.

actor.label: Very large online platform
actor.note: 45m+ average monthly active EU recipients, designated by the Commission.

actor.label: Trader
actor.note: Marketplace seller subject to DSA traceability duties.

actor.label: Affected person
actor.note: Protected party under the AI Act.

actor.label: User
actor.note: Protected party under the Data Act.

actor.label: Provider of data processing services
actor.note: Data Act Chapter VI; covers IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.

actor.label: Manufacturer of a product with digital elements
ICT third-party service provider
actor.note: DORA; includes critical ICT providers subject to the oversight framework.

actor.label: SME
actor.note: Small or medium-sized enterprise as defined in Recommendation 2003/361/EC.

actor.label: Researcher
actor.note: Including vetted researchers under DSA Art. 40(4).

actor.label: Critical-sector organisation
actor.note: Umbrella term used by the applicability engine. Covers NIS2 essential and important entities and CER critical entities; which of those an organisation is depends on sector and size.

activity.label: Placing a general-purpose AI model on the market
Placing connected products on the market
Placing products with digital elements on the market

territory.label: Outside the EU, serving EU users

instrument_kind.label: Regulation
instrument_kind.note: Directly applicable in all Member States. No transposition.

instrument_kind.label: Directive
instrument_kind.note: Requires national transposition. Obligations bite at national, not EU, dates.

instrument_kind.label: Proposal
instrument_kind.note: Not binding law. Must never be presented as an Act.

instrument_kind.label: Code of practice
instrument_kind.note: Voluntary unless and until made binding.

status.label: Proposal
status.note: Published by the Commission. Not law.

status.label: In force
status.note: Legally binding. NOT the same as applicable: obligations may not yet bite, in whole or in part.

status.label: Applicable
status.note: Obligations bite. For staggered instruments, see milestones rather than this scalar.

status.label: Partly applicable
status.note: Some tranches of obligations apply and others do not. Use milestones to see which.

status.label: Transposition pending
status.note: Directives only. See the per-Member-State transposition block.

status.label: Transposition overdue
status.note: Directives only. The transposition deadline has passed and transposition is not complete in every Member State; see the status note, the milestones and the per-Member-State transposition block. The obligations that bind a reader are still the national ones.

status.label: Stalled
status.note: In the legislative process but without a path forward at the recorded date.

scope_class.label: Core
scope_class.note: Analysed at length in this brief.

scope_class.label: Adjacent
scope_class.note: Part of the EU digital acquis, mapped and profiled here but not analysed at length.

scope_class.label: Referenced
scope_class.note: Named and placed, but outside this brief's analytical scope.

event_type.label: Entry into force
event_type.note: The instrument becomes legally binding. Distinct from application.

event_type.label: Application date
event_type.note: Obligations begin to bite. Distinct from entry into force.

event_type.label: Transposition deadline
event_type.note: Directives only. The date by which Member States must have transposed.

event_type.label: Adoption
event_type.note: The co-legislators sign the act — the date in its title ("of 13 June 2024"). Nothing applies yet.

event_type.label: Publication in the Official Journal
event_type.note: The act is published in the Official Journal. Entry into force is counted from this date, not from adoption.

date_precision.label: Month only
date_precision.note: Stored as the first of the month. The day is not published.

claim_type.label: Interpretation
claim_type.note: A reading of what the law or the evidence means.

claim_type.label: Forecast
claim_type.note: A statement about what will or may happen.

claim_type.label: Derived fact
claim_type.note: A figure this site computes from other registered claims. The claim records its inputs, formula, result and rounding, so the arithmetic can be re-run; a source that states the number itself would make it a fact, not a derivation.

claim_type.label: Attributed view
claim_type.note: What a named actor states or argues. The site reports the position and does not adopt it; the evidence is the actor's own publication, which settles that the view was held, not that it is right.

source_tier.label: Primary law and courts
source_tier.note: EUR-Lex, regulations, directives, CJEU, General Court, official Commission decisions and legislative documents.

source_tier.label: Regulators and EU institutions
source_tier.note: EDPB, EDPS, ENISA, national regulators and competent authorities, European Parliament, Council.

source_tier.label: Research
source_tier.note: Peer-reviewed research and established academic institutions.

source_tier.label: Industry, advocacy and press
source_tier.note: Industry bodies, advocacy organisations, commentary and journalism. Never to be presented as equivalent to primary law.

source_type.label: Court register entry or Official Journal notice of a case

url_status.label: Live
url_status.note: Fetched or seen in search results at the accessed date.

url_status.label: Unchecked
url_status.note: Recorded but not yet confirmed to resolve.

url_status.label: No URL recorded
url_status.note: The source is identified but no citable URL has been located.

supports.label: Partially supports
supports.note: The source establishes part of the proposition, a narrower case, or the components from which it is computed.

supports.label: Context only
supports.note: Informs the claim without establishing it. Not a citation.

action_status.label: Announced
action_status.note: Preliminary findings or an opened proceeding. No decision yet.

action_status.label: Closed by binding commitments
action_status.note: No fine. Compliance secured by commitment.

payment_status.label: Not yet payable
payment_status.note: Typically because the decision is annulled or under appeal.

transposition_state.label: Referred to the Court of Justice
Unknown
transposition_state.note: Not established at the recorded verification date.

relationship_kind.label: Overlaps with
relationship_kind.note: Both instruments reach the same conduct.

relationship_kind.label: Sequences with
relationship_kind.note: One applies before or feeds into the other.

outcome.label: Yes
outcome.note: On the facts given, this instrument applies.

outcome.label: Potentially applicable
outcome.note: Applies on the most common reading of these facts, but turns on a condition the questionnaire has not established.

outcome.label: Potentially applicable
outcome.note: May apply. Depends on facts this questionnaire does not ask for.

outcome.label: Probably not
outcome.note: On the facts given this instrument probably does not apply — but absence of an obligation is not a safe harbour.

outcome.label: Not determined
outcome.note: No rule in this dataset covers the combination selected. That is absence of knowledge, NOT evidence of non-applicability.

dna_dimension.label: Regulated actor
dna_dimension.note: Who the instrument places obligations on.

dna_dimension.label: Protected party
dna_dimension.note: Whose interests it exists to protect.

dna_dimension.label: Risk logic
dna_dimension.note: The organising idea by which obligations scale.

dna_dimension.label: Obligations
dna_dimension.note: The anchor provisions carrying the substantive duties.

dna_dimension.label: Competent authority
dna_dimension.note: DERIVED from institutions.json rather than stored on the instrument.

dna_dimension.label: Implementation model
dna_dimension.note: Directly applicable, or requiring national transposition.

dna_dimension.label: Key dates
dna_dimension.note: DERIVED from timeline.json via the instrument's milestones.

appeal_status.label: No appeal route engaged
appeal_status.note: Nothing to appeal — typically preliminary findings, or a matter closed by commitments.

appeal_status.label: No appeal lodged
appeal_status.note: Established that no appeal was brought within the period.

appeal_status.label: Under appeal
appeal_status.note: An appeal has been lodged and not yet decided.

appeal_status.label: Appeal decided
appeal_status.note: See the judicial record for the outcome.

appeal_status.label: Unknown
appeal_status.note: Researched. Whether an appeal was lodged is not publicly determinable, or has not been established here.

pipeline_stage.label: Investigation
pipeline_stage.note: Proceedings opened against a named entity.

pipeline_stage.label: Enforcement action
pipeline_stage.note: The authority has acted — preliminary findings count here, a decision does not yet exist.

pipeline_stage.label: Decision
pipeline_stage.note: A decision has been adopted. Preliminary findings are NOT a decision.

pipeline_stage.label: Payment / collection
pipeline_stage.note: Money has actually moved. The brief's central point is that this is a different quantity from the announced figure.

pipeline_stage.label: Behavioural change
pipeline_stage.note: Conduct is documented to have changed.

stage_state.label: Reached
stage_state.note: The record supports this stage having been reached.

stage_state.label: Not reached
stage_state.note: The record supports this stage NOT having been reached.

stage_state.label: Unknown
stage_state.note: Researched or derivable in principle, but not determinable from the record. NEVER rendered as zero, and never counted as either reached or not reached.

stage_state.label: Not applicable
stage_state.note: The stage cannot arise for this kind of action — an appeal stage for preliminary findings, a payment stage where no fine was imposed.

evidence_status.label: Direct
evidence_status.note: An external source states the proposition. Derived at render time from the claim's source references; never stored.

evidence_status.label: Partial
evidence_status.note: External sources establish part of the proposition, a narrower case, or the components from which it is computed — but none states it whole.

evidence_status.label: Derived
evidence_status.note: The proposition is computed by this site from other registered claims. Its strength is that of its inputs and its arithmetic, both of which are recorded.

evidence_status.label: Context only
evidence_status.note: External sources inform the claim without establishing any part of it. Context is not a citation.

evidence_status.label: Unverified
evidence_status.note: No external source states or part-states the proposition; the only support recorded is the brief itself.

evidence_status.label: Disputed
evidence_status.note: Sources recorded on the claim disagree about the proposition itself. The claim carries the disagreement rather than choosing a side silently.

remediation.label: Missing primary source
remediation.note: A claim of law or fact whose strongest external support is not tier 1 or 2. Derived.

remediation.label: Missing locator
remediation.note: A direct source reference without a locator specific enough for another person to reach the evidence without reading the whole document. Derived.

remediation.label: Rests on the brief alone
remediation.note: A claim that owes verification and whose only direct support is the brief itself. Derived.

remediation.label: Secondary sources only
remediation.note: Every external source is tier 3 or 4. Derived.

remediation.label: Unofficial reproduction only
remediation.note: A claim of law whose only external support for the legal text is an unofficial reproduction of it rather than the Official Journal or EUR-Lex. Derived from the source's reproduces field.

remediation.label: Derivation undocumented
remediation.note: A derived claim whose inputs, formula or result are missing or do not recompute. Derived.

remediation.label: Possibly composite
remediation.note: Heuristic: the statement carries several propositions or several figures, each of which may need its own source. Derived; never blocking.

remediation.label: Review due
remediation.note: The record is past the review interval of its freshness risk class. Derived.

remediation.label: Named reference gap
remediation.note: A person has recorded that part of the claim's sourcing is missing (reference_gap). Cleared only by a person.

remediation.label: Claim too broad
remediation.note: Judged: the statement asserts more than any recorded source could carry. Stored in the claim's remediation field.

remediation.label: Interpretation presented as fact
remediation.note: Judged: the prose states as fact something the data records as the author's reading. Stored.

remediation.label: Contested
remediation.note: Judged: the proposition is disputed between sources or actors. Stored; the claim also carries a contested block.

remediation.label: Low value
remediation.note: Judged: verification effort would exceed what the claim carries in the argument. Stored, never used to hide a gap.

prose_class.label: Author synthesis
prose_class.note: An inference the author draws across registered facts. Not a sourced finding, and not something a citation could settle.

prose_class.label: Author critique
prose_class.note: An analytical or normative assessment by the author.

prose_class.label: Recommendation
prose_class.note: What the author proposes should be done. Normative by construction.

prose_class.label: Signpost
prose_class.note: Framing or navigation that asserts nothing about the law or the world.

prose_class.label: Method note
prose_class.note: How the site or this brief was made, or how to read it. A statement by the author about their own work.

freshness_risk.label: Critical
freshness_risk.note: Legal status in motion: a pending appeal, a preliminary finding, an unknown payment, or a scheduled event within 60 days. Its review interval is set in js/evidence-model.js RISK_TTL_DAYS and nowhere else.

freshness_risk.label: High
freshness_risk.note: Institutional status or current implementation: legislative status, transposition, competences, open enforcement. Its review interval is set in js/evidence-model.js RISK_TTL_DAYS and nowhere else.

freshness_risk.label: Medium
freshness_risk.note: General claims of fact and law that can move but rarely do. Its review interval is set in js/evidence-model.js RISK_TTL_DAYS and nowhere else.

freshness_risk.label: Low
freshness_risk.note: Historical context and the author's own arguments. Its review interval is set in js/evidence-model.js RISK_TTL_DAYS and nowhere else.

freshness_state.label: Fresh
freshness_state.note: Verified within half of its risk class's review interval.

freshness_state.label: Aging
freshness_state.note: Within its review interval, past half of it.

freshness_state.label: Review due
freshness_state.note: Past its review interval, within twice it.

freshness_state.label: Stale
freshness_state.note: Past twice its review interval, or never verified.

finality.label: Final
finality.note: The act can no longer be challenged, or a challenge has been finally decided. Derived at render time from the enforcement record.

finality.label: Not final
finality.note: A preliminary step, or a decision under appeal or remitted for re-decision. Derived.

finality.label: Finality unknown
finality.note: The record cannot settle whether the act is final. Never counted as final or as not final.

procedural_stage.label: Preliminary finding
procedural_stage.note: The authority has stated a provisional view. Not a decision.

procedural_stage.label: Decision
procedural_stage.note: The authority has adopted a decision.

procedural_stage.label: Commitments
procedural_stage.note: The case was closed by binding commitments rather than a finding of infringement.

procedural_stage.label: Under appeal
procedural_stage.note: The decision is before a court.

procedural_stage.label: Annulled
procedural_stage.note: A court has annulled the act.

procedural_stage.label: Remitted
procedural_stage.note: Annulled and sent back to the authority for re-decision.

procedural_stage.label: No proceedings
procedural_stage.note: The record documents that no proceedings were opened.
